fields.description: Master switch for the scheduled backups (02:00 daily, 03:00 Sundays) and the staleness watchdog. Off, nothing is scheduled. Run Backup Now works either way, so you can prove the setup before switching this on.
fields.label: Enable Offsite Backups

fields.description: ID of the destination folder, taken from its Drive URL (.../folders/<this>). It must live on a Shared Drive and it must be dedicated to these backups — retention deletes by age, not by filename, so anything else parked in the folder is in scope.
fields.label: Drive Folder ID

fields.description: The whole downloaded service account key file, braces included. Stored encrypted. Use a service account dedicated to backups — not the one the project-folder sync uses — and share the backup folder with its client_email as Content manager.
fields.label: Service Account JSON Key

fields.description: Checks the folder, whether it is on a Shared Drive, and whether this service account can actually add and delete files in it.
fields.label: Test Connection

fields.description: Queues a backup on the long queue now. Progress lands in Offsite Backup Log.
fields.label: Run Backup Now

fields.description: Delete objects in the folder older than this many days. 0 turns pruning off entirely and keeps everything forever.
fields.label: Retention (days)

fields.description: Safety floor. The newest this many objects are never pruned regardless of age, and pruning is skipped altogether when the folder listing returns fewer than this — a partial listing must not cascade into deletion.
fields.label: Always Keep Newest

fields.description: Comma separated. Falls back to admin_alert_recipients in site_config.json when blank.
fields.label: Alert Recipients

fields.description: Email on every successful run as well as on failures. Off by default — the watchdog already reports silence.
fields.label: Notify On Success

fields.description: Alert when no backup of any type has succeeded within this many hours. 36 gives a missed nightly run one cycle of grace.
fields.label: Alert If Database Backup Older Than (hours)

fields.description: Checked separately from the database tier, against Weekly and Manual Full runs only — otherwise a healthy nightly database backup masks a weekly file backup that has been skipped every Sunday for months. 192 is eight days.
fields.label: Alert If Full Backup Older Than (hours)
